description: This PHP class defines a Membership display field component for reporting purposes within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base ListableDisplayField class and specifies methods to provide associated DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant fields.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: Represents a display field for membership data in reports, providing methods to specify DTO class, entity aliases, and fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used for query references.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields relevant to this display.
